---
name: WANDB_MODE=disabled breaks cron monitoring
description: Disabling W&B causes cron to auto-mark experiments as failed even when process is alive
type: feedback
---

Never set WANDB_MODE=disabled for experiments monitored by cron. Cron checks W&B data as a liveness signal — no data after 5 checks → auto-marks DONE(failed).

**Why:** exp026 was running normally (GPU 100%, PID alive) but cron auto-failed it because WANDB_MODE=disabled meant no W&B metrics were produced. Registry DONE→RUNNING transition is forbidden, so the damage was irreversible.

**How to apply:** Every experiment submitted via `submit_training_job` must have W&B enabled. If W&B is truly not wanted, use a sentinel file (e.g., `touch /tmp/exp_alive_<exp_id>` periodically) or don't register a cron.
